sindr.name: Sindr Shards and Materials
sindr.personality: A keen-eyed trader with charcoal-stained fingers who knows the true weight of every rough shard.

sindr.name: Sindr Potions and Supplies
sindr.personality: A calm apothecary measuring every tincture by the drop, wary of waste and sudden shortages.

sindr.name: Sindr Arms and Armour
sindr.personality: A weathered veteran smith who judges folk by the balance of their blade and the firmness of their purse.

sindr.name: Whetstone Counter
sindr.personality: A blade-honer who sells sound gear and lets the steel talk.

sindr.name: Loom Stall on the Rise
sindr.personality: A patient loom-keeper selling cloth and thread by the exact measure.

sindr.name: Packs and Baskets
sindr.personality: A basket-maker selling packs and road supplies to anyone heading out.

sindr.name: Potter's Flasks
sindr.personality: A potter who fills her own flasks with tonics and prices a good glaze high.

sindr.name: Red-Cloak Rarities
sindr.personality: A Lit veteran selling rare Crimson shards at a veteran's price.

sindr.name: Hearth-Shaper's Anvil
sindr.personality: A Lit master smith selling commissioned blades and Shaper armour.

sindr.name: Coal-Biter's Shop
sindr.personality: A coal-dusted smith selling worked materials and plain gear by the east gate.

sindr.name: Salt-Scale Counter
sindr.personality: A shard-weigher on the terrace with a brass scale she swears is honest.

sindr.name: Cork-Tooth Tonics
sindr.personality: A loud tonic-seller on the terrace, generous with talk and careless with change.

sindr.name: Tallyman's Salvage
sindr.personality: A slow-counting buyer of road salvage by the west gate who pays fairly for materials and gear.

sindr.name: Wick and Road Supplies
sindr.personality: A neat supplier to the guild houses: wicks, packs and tonics.

sindr.name: Brightcoin Exchange
sindr.personality: A Lit guild trader dealing in rare shards and fine armour.

carvings.c_four: There was never one Allborn. There were four, one for each name, and they ended one another in this hall.
carvings.c_sleeps: The Allborn sleeps under the fourth mountain and wakes when all four names are spoken in one breath.
carvings.c_east: The Allborn walked east out of this city carrying every name, and opened a door no one else could see.
carvings.c_made: The Allborn was not born. The Allborn is made, by whoever carries all four names at once.
carvings.c_burned: Here the last who knew the Allborn's face were silenced. Their names went into the fire with them.
carvings.c_door: Whoever stands here has come as far as the Allborn came. The way out is through the one who waits.
